text_block_list.text:
Having finished her intense training at 
summer camp and returned to the academy, 
Hokko Tarumae was diligently carrying out 
her usual training routine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... The clock is shaving down... Then 
again, obviously it'd be faster than on 
the sand...
choice_data_list: You've definitely built up real ability!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Do you think so...? Hmm...
choice_data_list:
(Maybe she doesn't really feel it yet 
herself?)

text_block_list.text:
Hah! You're right, from where I'm 
standing, there's still a ton of issues to 
tackle!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If ya wanna get strong, bring it on. I'll 
give ya a special retraining myself!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san... Could it be that you're trying 
to help out?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah?! The hell it is! I just won't be 
satisfied until I pay you back for the 
training camp!
choice_data_list: A debt from the training camp?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um, actually, back during summer training 
camp—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first pair up with the person 
next to you for 15-15s! Take turns timing 
each other for 3 sets!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So lame, 15 seconds is way too slow. I'm 
blastin' through in 13!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, you can't! The textbook says you 
have to build it up gradually to get the 
proper effect...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? Don't you go bossing me around!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it'd be a waste if our efficiency 
dropped. Besides... I really want to see 
how you do things, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Look at how that senior runs after 
conquering so many G1s...! The secret to 
it has to be solid fundamentals!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! What's that even mean... Damn it, 
let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! All right! Wow, even the sub-second 
margin of error is tiny... Hmm, so that's 
what it feels like...

text_block_list.name: Espo & Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Taaaaahhh--! Uoraaaahhh--!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*... Not bad...! Only winning 
by a neck against a junior is totally 
unacceptable! One more time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! Next time, the win will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Damn it... that hurts...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did the skin on the sole of your foot 
peel off? I have some bandages!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't need it. I don't take handouts.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, we have our match tomorrow, right?! 
If you're not in top shape, winning won't 
make me happy at all!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And like that... we ended up spending 
quite a bit of time together.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Espo-san hates losing so much that 
her drive pulled me along to do my best 
too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So it's really not something you need to 
repay me for, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shut up with your whining! A-anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, who else besides me could even 
keep up with how strong you are right 
now?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"My strength right now... huh. Am I really 
getting stronger, I wonder...?!"
choice_data_list: Let's see the fruits of our training camp!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Right! In that case, Espo-san! Let's 
compete with what we trained the hardest 
on during the camp!

The match that began after moving 
locations was a simple tandem run. It 
turned out to be an even more heated 
battle than during summer training 
camp...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! You've still got that 
sharp kick, as always!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! Alright! It looks like I've really 
gotten faster!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa, feels like I could keep swimming 
forever...♪ I'm not tired at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! Just how much stamina do 
you have...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Right now, I feel like I could swim 
all the way to Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah... whoa! My thighs feel 
light... My leg turnover is so sharp.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, look at how deep these 
footprints are...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's do one more! On an even steeper hill 
this time!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Espo
text_block_list.text: Fngiiiiiiigh...! Gwoooooooh...!

The two faced off in a giant tire-pulling 
match. Even as their knees threatened to 
buckle, they powered through on pure 
guts...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah~! That was a great match! With 
this, I feel like I'll be able to fire 
myself up when it counts in the race!

With the textbook in hand, I read out the 
question. Hokko Tarumae raised her paddle 
without a moment's hesitation...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The answer is "False"! Lipids cannot 
be used as an energy source for 
fast-twitch muscle fibers!
choice_data_list: Correct! That's ten in a row!
Correct! That's ten in a row!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! THIS is the match?! Wait, is 
there even any point to me being here?! 
Ahh—?!
